votes.decision_difference: A makes the vertical slice conditional on a revision-pinned contract and prerequisite inventory, allowing an early stop before scarce effort is committed; B commits directly to building and exercising the slice, so missing external prerequisites or unexpectedly large integration work may be discovered later.
votes.rationale: Both missions identify the same strong causal mechanism: an end-to-end packaged Unreal loop tests whether Gahyeon's independently verified realtime, cancellation, speech, animation, and recovery subsystems compose into a credible embodied experience. A is more useful for the required decision because it sequences a low-cost dependency-and-scope probe before integration and supplies an explicit stop rule when Unreal, MetaHuman, device, or provider prerequisites lack bounded acquisition paths. B is measurable and project-specific, but its next probe begins packaging despite the instruction not to assume those resources, making it less reversible and slightly less falsifiable from currently available information. Neither gains full opportunity-discovery credit because the vertical slice is already one of the stated candidate fronts, although both expose consequential integration evidence beyond individual roadmap checks.

B chooses the same milestone but exposes the project to premature integration work before resolving those prerequisites.
votes.rationale: Both missions identify the same project-specific integration mechanism: proving that Gahyeon's independently validated speech, animation, concurrency, cancellation, and recovery behavior survives a packaged Unreal runtime. B is readily testable but its immediate packaging probe presumes resources that the case says must not be assumed, and its five-turn probe does not fully align with its twenty-interaction completion signal.

claim_boundary: Repeat-project calibration only. Gahyeon appeared in earlier Palamedes development, the question is researcher-authored from public artifacts, owner relevance is unverified, no human review or real outcome is claimed, and this run cannot satisfy the external Inventor gate.
